versions.changelog:
No user-facing or internal changes were detected in this version.

- Version bump only; no code or documentation changes.
- All features and APIs remain unchanged.

Initial release of Communication DNA — build communication profiles from transcriptions and integrate with CRM/knowledge base.

- Analyze TXT, SRT, VTT, or JSON meeting/speech transcripts for vocabulary, filler words, commitments, sentiment arcs, and topics.
- Auto-generate speaker profiles and compare communication styles.
- CLI and web UI for ingestion, analysis, and searching.
- Integration with Personal CRM and Knowledge Base for cross-linking and advanced search.
- No external dependencies required for core functionality (Flask optional for web UI).
